rv.q: It takes talent and chutzpah to somehow humanize characters that at first glance seem the very antithesis of human. Joy Gregory does just that in Saint Megan, the latest triumph from L.A.'s Rogue Machine Theatre.
That and Patel's direction, which delivers spot-on performances from everyone — although it is Sorsa's unyielding matriarch that proves most fascinating and delivers the show's powerful catharsis.
